liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Black Throated Wind** (4 reviews, 2 other sources): The crowd goes wild when Black Throated Wind returns to the setlist; Reviewer says Bobby sang Black Throated Wind beautifully [4][5][23][25][27][29]
- **Blow Away** (4 reviews): Reviewer says the Blow Away reprise brought the building to its knees, with the full band coming back out and lighting it up; Reviewer calls Blow Away the other highlight of the night [24][25][26][29]
- **Man Smart, Woman Smarter** (1 review): About 3:13 into the jam out of this song, Eyes of the World is hinted at; Jerry rips and the crowd erupts [28]
- **Drums** (1 other source): The second-set jam contains an Eyes Of The World tease [8]

## Setlist highlights

- **Black Throated Wind**: back after 146 archived shows (706 days) [32]
- **drops or cuts in Blow Away @4:27 and**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [32]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-03-16.sbd.munder.tetzeli.fix-5227.76037.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 22 songs; 181 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Patches were applied to d1t07 and d1t09 from an earlier edit; no audience recording was available for repairs [1]
- **gd1990-03-16.nak300.juteau.116749.flac**: source not stated; 20 songs; 174 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1990-03-16.mtx.hansokolow.96549.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 167 min; rated 4.56/5 by 9 [5]
- **gd90-03-16.sbd.willy.5227.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 165 min; rated 4.17/5 by 30 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard has a couple of glitches, and the Blow Away set closer is severely damaged; Reviewer reports only a two-second dropout in Blow Away; otherwise a crisp soundboard whose loud crowd gives it an audience-tape feel; Minor glitches in the recording keep the reviewer from giving it a top rating [20][23][27][28][29]
- **gd1990-03-16.sbd.miller.85201.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 3.83/5 by 6 [8]. Said about its sound: Touch Of Grey and The Last Time carry patches; the patch source was off pitch and hard to correct [8]

## Around the show

- Many fans took the Blow Away ending for a halftime break and left for the restrooms, then rushed back as the band returned [24]
- Black Throated Wind followed two strong nights that had surprises Loose Lucy, Easy to Love You and Revolution [25]
- Reviewer considers the whole Capital Centre run of shows legendary, each worth a very strong five stars [27]
- The previous night, 1990-03-15, was Phil's 50th birthday and got a limited-edition Tarrapin Station release [31]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-03-16.sbd.munder.tetzeli.fix-5227.76037.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Seamless and patched edit of shnid 5227 [1]. Also: This FLAC fix of shnid 5227 removes the overlap between CDs 2 and 3 and uses shntool to clean up SBEs [1]
- **gd1990-03-16.nak300.juteau.116749.flac**: transferred by Jeff Bowen;Brad Foster; source: Source: (OTS) Nakamichi cm300/cp4's > Sony TCD-D10; [4]. Also: The Last Time from 0:26 to the end is patched using shnid 83791; master shared by Gene, transfer by Jeff [4]
- **gd1990-03-16.mtx.hansokolow.96549.flac16**: source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [5]. Also: Matrix made by hansokolow in ProTools, built on a fix of shnid 5227 (soundboard via CDR, EAC, SHN) [5]
- **gd90-03-16.sbd.willy.5227.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > ? > CDR> WAV>SHN [6]
- **gd1990-03-16.sbd.miller.85201.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat (44.1k) D [8]. Also: Sennheiser 4xx to cassette master to cassette to Sound Forge WAV; patch recorded by Jeff Hubbard, transferred by Charles Bandrofcheck [8]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Dave Goodwich: [30th Anniversary of The Grateful Dead's Spring 1990 Tour: The Capital Centre, Landover, MD 3/16/90 - Glide Magazine](https://glidemagazine.com/241539/30th-anniversary-of-grateful-deads-spring-1990-tour-3-16-90-the-capital-centre-landover-md/) [33]
- Fan art by keyboardpiano: [Grateful Dead Terrapin Station Spring 1990 Capital Centre](https://www.keyboardpiano.org/products/grateful-dead-terrapin-station-spring-1990-capital.html) [34]

Reviewer likes the rewritten lyrics in the returning Black Throated Wind
Reviewer considers the whole Capital Centre run of shows legendary, each worth a very strong five stars
About 3:13 into the jam out of this song, Eyes of the World is hinted at; Jerry rips and the crowd erupts
Reviewer calls this an excellent matrix source for capturing the Eyes of the World moment
Reviewer still dislikes the new Black Throated Wind lyrics but enjoyed the moment
Reviewer finds the extended Blow Away much less bad than it seemed at the time
Reviewer doubts it is a matrix, thinking the crowd is simply very excitable
The previous night, 1990-03-15, was Phil's 50th birthday and got a limited-edition Tarrapin Station release
This FLAC fix of shnid 5227 removes the overlap between CDs 2 and 3 and uses shntool to clean up SBEs
Patches were applied to d1t07 and d1t09 from an earlier edit; no audience recording was available for repairs
Black Throated Wind was last played 1974-10-19, according to the uploader's notes
The Last Time from 0:26 to the end is patched using shnid 83791; master shared by Gene, transfer by Jeff
Matrix made by hansokolow in ProTools, built on a fix of shnid 5227 (soundboard via CDR, EAC, SHN)
The notes list a cut and splice in Black Throated Wind at 2:32
Sennheiser 4xx to cassette master to cassette to Sound Forge WAV; patch recorded by Jeff Hubbard, transferred by Charles Bandrofcheck
Touch Of Grey and The Last Time carry patches; the patch source was off pitch and hard to correct
